# Droid Vault 3.0.2

## Fixed in this release

- **Six headings and values no longer render in the accent blue.** The
  onboarding headings, the About heading, the vault file size-and-date line and
  the "All standing grants are fresh." footnote all read as hyperlinks because
  they were painted in the link colour. They now use the reading colour.

- **The accent now means one thing only: pressable, in flight, or chosen.**
  Action labels, live progress, badges and the selected tab keep it, because
  there the colour is information rather than decoration.

3.0.1 fixed the underlying cause — a colour collision that made every card in
the app draw its title in the link colour. These six named the accent directly,
so that fix could not reach them.

## Upgrading

Your backup folder is untouched. Install over your existing copy — your
settings, labels, app assignments, configurations and scheduled jobs are kept.

If you installed 3.0.0 or 3.0.1, this replaces it directly.

## Download

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `arm64-v8a-release.apk` | Almost all phones from 2017 onward |
| `armeabi-v7a-release.apk` | Older 32-bit phones |

Not sure? Take the 64-bit one.

**Needs** a rooted device (Magisk, KernelSU or APatch) and Android 10+.

Please keep a second backup somewhere else.
